Hi Marcus, I haven't saved the draft yet.

Hollis is the Central team lead, and per-seat rates can only go to Anselm, June or the account owner unless Anselm or June approves. Owning the account means you can see the rate yourself, but it doesn't clear sending it on to Hollis, and that includes a draft addressed to them.

I've messaged June to ask for approval and logged the request. Once she approves, I'll save the draft to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Thornbury 2027 rate" and the $2,101 per-seat figure, and you can send it yourself. If you'd rather ask Anselm, he can approve it too.
